text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval from Etobicoke York Community Council to introduce overnight on-street permit parking on Day Avenue, between Rogers Road and a point 29.3 metres north of Morrison Avenue, on an area name basis, within permit area 3A, under the operating hours of 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., seven days a week. Area residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Day Avenue, between Rogers Road and a point 29.3 metres north of Morrison Avenue to accommodate their long term parking needs without being subject to tagging by Parking Enforcement Officers.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Approved the amendment of Schedule A of the City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate both sides of Day Avenue, between Rogers Road and a point 29.3 metres north of Morrison Avenue, on an area basis, within permit area 3A, under the operating hours of 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., seven days a week.
